title: Travis County turnout on day one
subtitle: Share of registered voters who voted on day one, midterm years
source: KUT, from Texas Secretary of State data
alt: Bar chart from KUT, using Texas Secretary of State data: on the first day of early voting in Travis County, 4.14% of registered voters cast a ballot in the 2018 midterm, 2.8% in 2022 and about 4.3% in 2026.
